title: Add .dockerignore for cam-worker image build context
description: docker build for the cam-worker image uses build context '.' (repo root) with no .dockerignore, so node_modules, dist, .git, .claude logs, claude-code-harness, and *.bun-build temps are all tarred and sent to the daemon each build. The Dockerfile never COPYs the context (installs via apt/npm; workspace is bind-mounted at run), so this is pure wasted transfer. Add a .dockerignore excluding node_modules, dist, .git, .claude, *.bun-build, coverage, and other non-build artifacts. Surfaced during CAM-175 (found a 4.9G context from ~84 orphan .bun-build files).
